scope: U5/U6/U7/U8/U9/U10 only; U11 explicitly excluded for separate audit
pin_maps_note: U9.9 and U10.7 are KiCad numbering for manufacturer unnumbered exposed pads, not extra numbered lead pins. PDF data was inspected through official TI web access; raw PDF bytes are not archived or hash-certified here.

mismatches.consequence: Finite-copper USB limiter current and IQ enter at EN instead of IN; a net-name match is insufficient. Magnitude/sign of voltage bias was not computed. All derived port guards, USB circuit cases and probes must be rebound to the actual input where applicable.

ground_and_package_limits.note: GND pin5 is a valid ground contact. TI p.5 explicitly says PowerPAD is internally connected to GND and requires external grounding; candidate39 exposed pad7 is GND, but the ledger only has U10.5. Omitted internal pin5/EP7 current sharing is an additional package-ground idealization. No quantified package resistance/current split is established; do not silently union disconnected finite lands.

PGND1 is valid converter power return, AGND4 valid sense reference. TI p.4 requires exposed pad to AGND; native pad9 is GND, and fixed-output FB5 is also GND. Neither pad9 nor FB5 is used as a separate ledger contact. TI pin table does not justify declaring all ground-named/control pads ideal internal power-return pins; package grounding and thermal behavior remain outside the two-reference model.

Power return10 and quiet/control ground4 are distinct valid roles. Grounded PS/SYNC1, FB2_6, VSEL15 are controls, not extra power grounds. Package ground transfer/sharing remains a circuit idealization.

limits: Pin-function and source binding audit only; no physical footprint dimensional/orientation certification, DC rerun, dynamics, thermal qualification, switch-state validation or final-board acceptance.
Pad-level equality between candidate19 and candidate39 does not prove equality of all intervening power copper or numerical applicability.

U7 output2/7 and U8 output1/8 are separate finite contacts joined to ideal device nodes by explicit zero-volt sources, not a single geometric contact union. This includes all documented output leads but omits package/solder resistance.

U9 L2.2 is the actual external output-inductor terminal on +3V3_CORE; U9.6 is VOS sense only. U9.7 to L2.1 switching path is represented by the averaged total-efficiency converter, not separately solved.
